cohort: Women with a live singleton pregnancy and prior Caesarean delivery
finding: Neonatal morbidity was slightly increased among women with a TOLAC, and morbidity and mortality were considerably increased in cases of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Neonatal morbidity appears slightly increased among women who attempt a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC), with significantly increased risks in cases of uterine rupture.
